findings.finding: Cleanup could be skipped when capture parsing or persistence failed
findings.resolution_evidence: Unconditional outer finally now invokes owned.cleanup; fresh malformed/write-failure/SIGTERM controls pass against the exact final launcher.

findings.finding: Audit did not require exact scenario matrix or consistent identity
findings.resolution_evidence: Auditor now requires the original nine tuples and consistent count/buffered/inherit/tenant across every phase.
Auditor validates stage interruption, promote/recovery flags, inherited epoch/checkpoint and unchanged replay.

findings.finding: Audit omitted two physical storage bounds
findings.resolution_evidence: All four original storage limits are enforced, including physical bytes<=1048576 and identity bytes<65536.

findings.finding: Observer skipped deleted extra SDK mappings
findings.resolution_evidence: Deleted SDK mapping rows are retained and rejected before inode dedup; regression executes this case.

findings.finding: Malformed expected hash raised before receipt retention
findings.resolution_evidence: Expected hashes require exactly64 hexadecimal characters; malformed values produce retained rejection; regression passes.

findings.finding: Direct preflight wait lacked an external watchdog
findings.resolution_evidence: Fresh preflight executed with timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=30s 20m, matching the existing phase deadline.

followup_result: No new material reachable correctness findings; reviewed task-owned source equals selected snapshot.
scope_limit: Cancellation control exercises an owned child plus containers before the matrix runner begins. It is not an active matrix-tree cancellation test. Interrupted first attempt retains its actual matrix cancellation/cleanup separately.

final_helper_review.finding: Stale auditor JSON could make a later crashed control borrow a prior rejection
final_helper_review.resolution: Delete owned temporary output before every invocation; require newly produced JSON; add an explicit crashed-auditor/stale-output control.

final_helper_review.finding: Folders strict preservation omitted branch and raw index identity
final_helper_review.resolution: Compare branch and initial index SHA in addition to byte/head/status/submodule checks; do not restore an external index delta.

final_helper_review.finding: Partial finalization retry could overwrite retained reports
final_helper_review.resolution: Fail before preexisting outputs; final report/input writes are exclusive. Base runtime/capture auditors also refuse preexisting output; isolated controls clear only owned temp outputs.

additional_integrity_hardening: Conflicting expected hashes across source/guard/binary inventories are retained and fail input integrity rather than being hidden by dictionary replacement.
final_helper_followup: No remaining material defect in concrete fixes. Scope separation accepted: producer9/30/120 observation closure and unchanged producer inputs are independent of explicit failed Folders preservation; overall not_fully_qualified.
